<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:IO-020:40604768518 -->
## Verified resolution — all original important criteria reviewed, direct closure

The whole-file reader now uses `InputStream.use` through `readAndClose`, so partial reads/error/close paths unwind ownership and preserve primary failures. Reviewed the actual production call, not only a helper name.

**All five original criteria pass on immutable `f37bf1416546ffe04bd1ec16707241cf662581b9`, [run40604768518](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40604768518):**
1. `readFailureClosesOnceAndKeepsCloseFailureSuppressed`: nine partial bytes, then actual IOException; close count1, throwing close retained as suppressed.
2. `successfulEmptyReadClosesOnce` and `successfulNonemptyReadClosesOnce`: exact bytes and close count1.
3. `successfulReadDoesNotHideAClosingFailure`: successful read followed by exact propagated close failure; primary-read/suppressed-close case also passes.
4. `NullProviderStreamTest.nullProviderInputStreamStillReportsNotFound`: real Android ContentResolver classes with attached registered provider under Robolectric; explicitly verifies actual null stream before the public KmpFile call, then FileNotFoundException and two provider opens.
5. `metadataFailureAfterSourceOpenClosesBeforePropagating`: actual production Coil/Okio/KmpFileFetcher pipeline opens a real FileInputStream, metadata fetch fails; exact origin retained, opens1/closes1, actual descriptor invalid and read throws IOException, source content intact.

**Evidence review:** all738 inputs checked against exact tested Git blobs, unchanged before/after maps, artifact digest/every XML hash/exact fresh tasks/runtime/SDK correspondence. IO27/27 passes; three of five Coil methods pass (byte parity, failed-fetch closure, actual decoder cancellation closure). The six methods required above completely pass.

**The whole workflow remains failed**,30/32 executions/eight fresh XML/zero skips. Two additional Coil fixtures fail before their final ownership assertions: null provider transport used an initially-null receiver context; suspended decoder error demanded object identity despite matching IOException type/message. Explicit outer context/invariant and strict exact-origin cause-chain assertions are being repaired without disabling recovery or removing FD/close checks; those extra methods are not accepted here and require their own fresh Coil-only run. They remain under BUILD-006/testing/release verification, not silently waived by this specific reader/fetch fix.

Controlled Robolectric resolver transport is not Android device/provider Binder IPC. Physical/minimum devices, native/provider grants/ownership, memory sanitizers, packaged consumers/API-ABI and dependency/legal/security/release gates remain open. No packages/releases/deployments published. Original issue body/title/labels/history retained; direct closure occurs before subsequent documentation.
